entities.name: María Antonia de Paz y Figueroa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Saint María Antonia de Paz y Figueroa, later known as Mama Antula in Santiagueño Quechua, was a Catholic religious sister who established the Daughters of the Divine Savior. She was—on the account of her model Christian life of heroic virtue—proclaimed to be venerable in 2010, and beatified on 27 August 2016. On 11 February 2024, she was canonised by Pope Francis. She is Argentina's first female saint.
